name: Inuktitut Numerals
morphology: Small numbers combine additive morphemes. 6–9 are (5 + X), teens are additive to 10, and twenties form a new unit.
context: Inuktitut numerals reflect counting on fingers and toes, forming a natural vigesimal system.
rules: 20 (inuit) acts as the next base unit.
All constructions are additive; no subtractive forms exist.
